derived_reference: market_implied fit B (1X2 + O/U 2.5 + main AH), plus lines only, residual <= 3pp

tags.balanced: Pinnacle 1X2 home and away odds both in [2.00, 3.50]
tags.even_odds: Pinnacle 1X2 home and away odds both >= 2.50 (raw quoted odds)
tags.use: tracking only; never changes a decision

selection_method: Highest positive-return probability per fixture and market group; expected return then odds break ties; no cap; configured excluded markets are rejected before selection
ranking_metric: probability of positive net return descending
model_role: Researched settlement probabilities select and rank the main shortlist
shortfall_reason: No candidate cleared the price-edge rule against a Pinnacle reference
warning: Research probabilities are model estimates and have not passed a forward calibration gate. Negative expected return remains eligible and flagged.

cagey_tier.rule: No narrow gate; per-market-source no-loss then expected return then odds; Over 1.5 uses uncorrected Pinnacle grid; binary price guard uses independent Pinnacle prices; narrow support is informational; configured excluded markets are rejected before selection

correction_rule: Derived plus lines (>= +1.0) are priced from the cagey-corrected matrix (c-cagey, 3% threshold); Pinnacle-quoted lines keep Pinnacle as the fair price; minus lines are never corrected.
research_rule: ten recent games weighted newest first; venue splits; verified xG if supplied; Poisson goal rates; context evidence shown separately
asian_handicap_selection: Highest positive-net-return probability among available quoted AH lines within (1.15, 2.00]; one per fixture/group
training_rule: Verified local competition history plus pre-cutoff free-source research; refresh failure retains valid cache with a warning

master_shortlist_old.probability_basis: Independent margin-free Pinnacle binary reference or uncorrected fit B; valid research/corrected distributions are diagnostics only; no blend or missing-evidence ranking bonus
master_shortlist_old.rule: Union of value and cagey SHORTLISTED offers only; odds (1.15,2.00]; kickoff 20 minutes–24 hours; fresh synchronized market references; no EV or probability eligibility floor; nominate fifteen when fifteen executable distinct fixtures exist, otherwise explicit shortfall; one market per match; market profit probability then market net EV then no-loss probability then odds; negative EV flagged; no automatic stakes; fifteen-match target, one selection per fixture; frozen training/research/weather review accompanies every pick; native Pinnacle Asian Handicap, home or away win, and Double Chance 1X or X2
master_shortlist_old.context_influence: Local training and researched form/xG inform source forecasts/nominations; master probabilities/ranking remain Pinnacle-referenced. Weather, team news, rest/travel, H2H, tactics and motivation are review context, with no unvalidated numerical adjustment.
master_shortlist_old.context_missing_policy: Remain eligible with explicit warnings; no missing-evidence ranking bonus

master_shortlist.status: live master: released by Paul on 14 Nov 2026 as a deliberate exception, without waiting for the live comparison verdict; graded beside the old master with the rollback rule in master_shortlist_config.json

timing_check.rule: the live master's: one generation clock; offer and ranking reference quoted 0-15 minutes before evaluation (none after it); reference inputs and offer at most 10 minutes apart
